case_number: 2024 INSC 1006; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 4211 OF 2009, 4213 OF 2009
summary: Property partition during owner's lifetime under Mohammedan Law; essential prerequisites of valid gift; nomenclature in mutation entry (Watni/Partition vs Oral Gift); applicability of Transfer of Property Act; no pre-existing rights in Muslim succession; oral partition not recognized; mutation evidence evaluated; constitutional protection for personal laws; Shayara Bano principles examined.
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of; respondents' entitlement confirmed; partition/gift claims rejected; plaintiffs entitled to 1/6 share, defendants 1 and 9 to 1/3 share each, defendant 11 to 1/6 share.
